name: crashkernel_reserve

grub_config.rationale: The safeguard edits the Linux GRUB configuration and requires an operator reboot.

storage.rationale: Linux-only boot configuration is verified by the handler's GRUB seam.

description: Reserve memory for the kdump capture kernel via the crashkernel= boot parameter

reservation.description: Kernel crashkernel reservation value, for example 512M-:256M.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard crashkernel_reserve; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.

windows.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard crashkernel_reserve; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.
